item.title: Gambonanza Build Guide - Core Directions and When to Pivot
item.description:
Not every direction works in every run. Good Gambonanza play is reading the shop and adapting. This guide covers the main directions, when each one works, and when to switch.

Do not force a build. Read what the shop and the boss preview give you, then commit. A flexible player with an average Gambit that fits their board beats a rigid player forcing a “best” Gambit they cannot trigger.

Direction 1: Tempo

Best for: Short, consistent games and any run where you want to end things before the counters matter.

item.title: Queen Supremacy Guide
item.description:
Queen Supremacy-TL;DR Check All Gambits Guide for the full breakdown. The Rook & Bishop Guide breaks this down in detail.

Deploy Queen on turn 2-4 (not turn 1, not turn 10).

Pair her with 1 Gambit. Win.

SHighest-impact piece per stock. Naked Queen = expensive target. Queen + 1 Gambit = game over.

When to Deploy - 3-Board Cheat Sheet

Board Deploy on Turn Why
4x4 2-3 Overkill, but a Goddess’s combo can end the game in 2 turns
5x5 2-4 Sweet spot-deploy early, stack Gambits
6x6+ 3-5 Clear a lane first, then Queen takes over

Rule: Never turn 1 on 5x5+. Deploy Knight/Bishop first to open a lane.
